Check client public-release boundaries

check_public_boundary.Rd

Check client-defined host, artifact, export, and schema restrictions without loading the client.

Usage

check_public_boundary(root, policy, schema_names = NULL)

Arguments

policy

Public-boundary policy list or explicit YAML filename; see details for accepted fields.

schema_names

Selected public operation names; NULL skips membership checks for built artifacts.

root

Explicit existing client root directory.

Value

Invisibly TRUE after printing a scan summary; raises an error when a policy restriction fails.

Details

Policy accepts forbidden_hosts, forbidden_files, forbidden_exports, forbidden_schemas, and api_exports regex strings plus a manual_exports sequence. With schema_names supplied, selected API exports must have an approved schema or manual mapping. Source scans include untracked nonignored files in Git projects. String policy filenames resolve against the R working directory.
